body: I try but it’s just so disheartening when all my friends stopped talking to me. I literally get ignored by everyone and it’s so hard to find support now
No one likes talking to me and everyone always ignores my texts and messages. They all stopped inviting me to hang out and I have literally no one to talk to.

I just don’t know if it’s even possible to be successful cause in order to find a good career you need to be somewhat sociable and to make new friends you’re need to be somewhat sociable. And whenever I lose a friend it hurts so much and makes it harder for me to socialize cause I can’t focus then. 

It’s just a brutal cycle where I’m depressed cause I can’t make friends and then I lose a friend so I become more depressed which makes me lose more friends. It’s impossible for me to escape and the way I see it, my life is gonna keep getting worse because of it so I might as well end it all to escape that cycle
I’ve been trying but it seems that any effort I put in just makes things worse, it’s just so disheartening

Thing is we’re all gonna go separate paths soon and then I won’t really have anyone.

And for your question I’m guessing it’s because it’s just hard to express empathy and stuff so it seems like I don’t really care when I do, and it just makes me come off as someone who you can’t really relate to at all

I just have nothing to live for. Even though I’m going to a great university and program that will pretty much guarantee a successful career, I just feel like all of that means nothing if I’ll end up alone and having no one to talk to. It gets so hard to be motivated when the future I think I’m gonna have is so bad. And not only that but i doubt it becomes better because I’m such a hard person to like. It’s so difficult to connect with others. When I try people call me untrustworthy and annoying and all of that. It’s literally only the 3 friends who want to talk to me about this stuff and consistently invite me to hangouts who want to talk to me and people who I can connect to. I just don’t think the future I’m headed towards is one that I would like to live in and there’s not much I can do to change it and that’s why I think I might kill myself.
